values.note: Every South site is a 30/50-amp electric site: $48 a night on the booking site for 2027 (2027-05-18 and 07-13 alike). The DNR rates table (Lakeport North and South Loops, 2026) lists $46 for 50-amp sites; its $41 20/30-amp rate applies only to North sites. A Recreation Passport is required for vehicle entry to all state park campgrounds.

fees.source: https://midnrreservations.com/ (Lakeport State Park, map 'South 301-356': 56 campsites on fee schedule -32491, feeTotal $48 for 2027-05-18 and 2027-07-13) + https://www.michigan.gov/dnr/things-to-do/camping-and-lodging/camping-and-lodging-rates-and-operating-dates (Lakeport, North and South Loops: Modern camping 50 AMP rate $46, 20/30 AMP rate $41) + https://www.michigan.gov/recsearch/parks/lakeport ('A Recreation Passport (park pass) is required for vehicle entry into all state park and forest campgrounds'), read 2026-10-25

hookups.source: https://www.michigan.gov/recsearch/parks/lakeport (Lakeport South Modern Campground: 'features 50-amp electrical') + https://midnrreservations.com/ (all 56 South campsites: 'Electric and Water Hookups=Electric Only', 'Electrical Service=30 Amps/50 Amps', 'Sewer Hookup=No'), read 2026-10-25

values.note: 56 campsites (301-356), all back-in on asphalt/grass pads; the booking site takes tents and trailers/RVs up to 40 ft on every one. Two vehicles per site. Two mini cabins (Cedar, White Pine) stand in the same campground.

sites.source: https://www.michigan.gov/recsearch/parks/lakeport (Lakeport South Modern Campground: 'Number of sites: 56', 'paved parking pads'; Cedar and White Pine Mini Cabins 'located in Lakeport's Modern South Campground') + https://midnrreservations.com/ (map 'South 301-356': 56 campsites, allowed equipment up to 'Trailer or RV up to 40'' on all 56, 'Pull Through=No', 'Ground Cover=Asphalt/Grass', 'Vehicles Per Site=2'), read 2026-10-25

values.note: One modern toilet/shower building; the toilet/shower building is open for the whole reservation season (DNR rates table). Jug fillers in the South campground.

facilities.source: https://www.michigan.gov/recsearch/parks/lakeport (Lakeport South Modern Campground: 'a modern toilet/shower building'; tags 'Modern campground', 'Sanitation station', 'Toilet & shower building'; group-camp entry: 'There are jug fillers in Lakeport's Modern South Campground') + https://www.michigan.gov/dnr/things-to-do/camping-and-lodging/camping-and-lodging-rates-and-operating-dates (Lakeport North and South Loops: modern toilet/shower building 'Available for all reservable season'), read 2026-10-25

values.note: Reserve online on MiDNRReservations or at 800-447-2757.

booking.source: https://www.michigan.gov/recsearch/parks/lakeport (Lakeport South Modern Campground: 'For reservations call 800-447-2757 or reserve online') + https://midnrreservations.com/ (56 bookable South campsites) + https://www.michigan.gov/dnr/things-to-do/camping-and-lodging/camping-and-lodging-rates-and-operating-dates (Lakeport, North and South Loops: reservation season starts May 1, ends October 21), read 2026-10-25

note: Lakeport State Park's smaller south modern campground, in woods 10 mi north of Port Huron (park campground address 7605 Lakeshore Road); paved pads. Set back from the Lake Huron shore (~2-min walk), not on the lake. The park's day-use area with the buoyed swim beach is about a mile south, across the village of Lakeport. The 194-site North campground is its own entry. --Claude
summary: DNR park page + booking site + DNR rates table, verified for the South campground alone: 56 sites (confirmed), 30/50-amp electric only (electric 50 confirmed; water/sewer false new), up to 40 ft (new), all back-in (pull_through false new), toilet/shower building + sanitation station (showers confirmed, flush/dump new), reservable on MiDNRReservations (platform confirmed from inheritance), reservation season May 1 - Oct 21 (confirmed). Fees 41-46 -> 48-48 (2027 booking site; South has no 20/30-amp sites, so the $41 base is North's only). Season not stated (reservation season only). Phone 810-327-6224 matches the park office. Note trimmed of field restatements.
flags: Pin looks ~620 m south of the campground: 43.1195,-82.4970 sits in woods beside M-25 at the park-road junction, with no sites in view. The nearest campground loop on Esri imagery, eight back-in rows of about the size of a 56-site loop set back a few hundred yards from the beach, is at about 43.1250,-82.4955; the larger North campground is further north. Suggest checking and moving the pin there (the booking-site maps carry no coordinates, so which loop is South rests on size and setting).
